FIRSTAMENDMENT
To Lease Agreement
by and between
M/s.Good Homes (Private) Limited ('Lessor") and Zameen Media (Private) Limited ("Lessee")
[Each a "Party" and, collectively, "Parties"]
This first amendment ("First Amendment") to the Lease Agreement dated 27thMay 2022
('Agreement") is made and entered into at Lahore on this 28th August, 2024.
WHEREAS
(A)

The Parties entered into the Agreement wherein the Lessor granted on lease, and the
Lessee took on lease from the Lessor, an area measuring 8000 Sq.ft.at the third floor of
the Building namely "New Auriga Shopping Mall" located at Plot No.41-G,Main
Boulevard Gulberg II, Lahore a ("Leased Premises"); and

(B)

The Parties hereby mutually agree to revise and amend the Agreement as per the terms
and conditions of this First Amendment.

NOW,THEREFORE , the Parties agree as follows:
1.

The First Amendment shall come into force onistOctober, 2024 ("Effective Date").

Lessor's Initials

Pge1 of 2
THIS DOCUMENT IS CONFIDENTIAL AND PROPRIETARY

Lessee's initials

4.

E-STAM P
CONTINUATION SHEET

First Amendment

2.

Pursuant to Article 4.1 of the Agreement, the Parties hereby mutually agree to further
extend the term of the Agreement for a period of three (3) years, commencing from the
Effective Date and ending on 30th September, 2027 ('Extended Term").

3.

The Parties agree that the monthly rent payable by the Lessee to the Lessor for the
Leased Premises during the first ten months of the Extended Term shall be Rs. 646,300
(Rupees Six Hundred Forty-Six Thousand Three Hundred) per month inclusive of all
applicable taxes and maintenance service charges ("Monthly Rent"). The Parties further
agree that the annual increment for the year 2025 shall be applicable from 1st August,
2025.

4.

This First Amendment shall be read as an integral part of the Agreement.

5.

All other terms and provisions in the Agreement shall mutatis mutandi.s apply and shall
continue in full force and effect in accordance with the terms mentioned therein. In the
event of any conflict, the terms of this First Amendment shall prevail, and any conflicting
term in the Agreement shall be deemed amended appropriately.

6.

All expressions and terms defined or used in the Agreement shall bear the same meaning
in this First Amendment, unless otherwise specified herein.
This First Amendment may be entered in to in counter parts, all of which taken together

IN WITNESS WHERE OF, the Parties here to have signed this First Amendment, having fully
understood the conditions set therein, of their own freewill, in the presence of witnesses.

FIRST AMENDMENT
to Lease Agreement
by and between
M/s. Good Homes (Private) Limited (Lessor") and Zameen Media (Private) Limited
("Lessee")
[Each a "Party" and, collectively, "Parties"]
13th
September
This first amendment ('First Amendment") to the Lease Agreement dated
28th
2021Agreement") is made and entered into at Lahore on this
August, 2024.
WHEREAS
(A)

The Parties entered into the Agreement wherein the Lessor granted on lease, and the
Lessee took on lease from the Lessor, an area measuring 27235 Sq.ft. at the third floor of
the Building namely "New Auriga Shopping Mall" located at Plot No. 41-G, Main Boulevard
Gulberg II, Lahore a (Leased Premises"); and

(B)

The Parties hereby mutually agree to revise and amend the Agreement as per the terms
and conditions of this First Amendment.

NOW, THEREFORE, the Parties agree as follows:
1.

The First Amendment shall come into force on 1st October, 2024 (Effective Date").

CONTINUATION SHEET

2.

Pursuant to Article 4.1 of the Agreement, the Parties hereby mutually agree to further
extend the term of the Agreement for a period of three (3) years, commencing from the
Effective Date and ending on 30th September, 2027 (Extended Term").

3.

The Parties agree that the monthly rent payable by the Lessee to the Lessor for the Leased
Premises during the first ten months of the Extended Term shall be Rs. 2,369,300 (Rupees
Two Million Three Hundred Sixty-Nine Thousand Three Hundred) per month inclusive of
all applicable taxes and maintenance service charges ("Monthly Rent"). The Parties
further agree that the annual increment for the year 2025 shall be applicable from 1st
August, 2025.

4.

This First Amendment shall be read as an integral part of the Agreement.

5.

All other terms and provisions in the Agreement shall mutatis mutandis apply and shall
continue in full force and effect in accordance with the terms mentioned therein. In the
event of any conflict, the terms of this First Amendment shall prevail, and any conflicting
term in the Agreement shall be deemed amended appropriately.

6.

All expressions and terms defined or used in the Agreement shall bear the same meaning
in this First Amendment, unless otherwise specified herein.

7.

This First Amendment may be entered into in counterparts, all of which taken together shall
constitute one and the same amendment.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the Parties hereto have signed this First Amendment, having fully
understood the conditions set therein, of their own freewill, in the presence of witnesses.
